# Hash-It

> Hash-It is a LeetCode and DSA (data structures and algorithms) tracker built on spaced repetition. You keep a DSA log of each coding problem you solve (LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, or any link), and Hash-It schedules when to re-solve it from scratch, right before you would forget the approach. Scheduling uses FSRS, the same algorithm Anki offers.

Website: https://hash-it.abhaydesu.me
Built by: Abhay (@abhaydesu, https://abhaydesu.me). Hash-It is independent and not affiliated with LeetCode.

## What it does

- Log a problem in seconds (⌘K / Ctrl+K): time taken, core idea, mistakes, and whether you solved it cold, with a hint, or failed.
- Daily review queue: problems come back when they are due, split into quick recall checks (a few minutes) and full re-solves (about 25 minutes). The daily cap is configurable.
- Import LeetCode history: screenshot your LeetCode progress page, paste it into any AI chatbot with Hash-It's prompt, upload the CSV. Any DSA sheet you track in CSV or Excel can be imported too. First reviews are spread over 60 days.
- Practice by pattern: pick a pattern (two pointers, sliding window, DP, graphs, and more) and get an easy, a medium and a hard problem you haven't solved yet.
- Weekly review: a confidence-rated recall check on problems at risk, plus a plan for the next week and the next LeetCode contest.
- Monthly mock: five timed problems drawn from your weakest topics; scores are kept month over month.
- Stats: streaks, activity, difficulty breakdown, stuck problems and common mistakes.

## Good fit for

- People preparing for coding interviews who keep forgetting problems they already solved.
- Anyone working through NeetCode 150, Blind 75, Grind 75 or any other DSA sheet who wants a revision schedule on top of it.
- Anyone looking for a DSA tracker or DSA log that covers every platform, not just LeetCode.
- Replacing a LeetCode tracking spreadsheet with automatic due dates.

## Pages

- [Home and FAQ](https://hash-it.abhaydesu.me/): what Hash-It is, how it works, frequently asked questions about tracking DSA.
- [How to remember DSA problems](https://hash-it.abhaydesu.me/guides/dsa-spaced-repetition): a guide to spaced repetition for DSA revision, including how often to revise problems, what to keep in a DSA log, and how to track DSA progress.
